copy.headline: Netflix Closes $380 Million Acquisition of Radford Studio Center
copy.caption: Netflix is the proud new owner of Radford Studio Center, the 98-year-old soundstage complex that was home to “Gunsmoke,” “The Mary Tyler Moore Show,” and “Seinfeld.” The streamer is set to close the $380 million acquisition this afternoon, the company said in a statement.
